reason: The plugin monitors OpenCode Go quota usage by fetching external usage data and presenting rolling, weekly, and monthly limits in the web interface, with an agent query tool.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中监控 OpenCode Go 的五小时、每周和每月用量，并通过圆环、展开卡片和智能体工具展示重置信息。
summaries.en: Monitors OpenCode Go five-hour, weekly, and monthly usage in DeepSeek Harness Web through a usage ring, expandable card, and agent query tool.

capabilities: Queries an external usage endpoint using a configured API key
Displays rolling, weekly, and monthly quota percentages and reset times in the web UI
Registers an agent tool for querying usage information
Refreshes usage data periodically through a host-side proxy route
